A '''slicer''' was employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Shortly before a [[Raid on the Pendari shipyards|raid]] on the Imperial [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pendari]], the Alliance paid the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] an undisclosed amount to break into the Imperial base command [[Computer/Legends|computer]]<ref name="gg11" /> and discover the refitting schedule of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Gallant Sun]]''.<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|I|316|''Gallant Sun''}}</ref> The slicer was successful, and the information obtained allowed the Rebels to know the precise time the ''Gallant Sun'' would be in space dock for repairs. As a result, the Alliance was able to destroy the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] with minimal casualties.<ref name="gg11" />

==Behind the scenes==
The slicer was first mentioned in the [[roleplaying game]] supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and published in [[1994]] by [[West End Games]].<ref name="gg11" />
